title: Twice Cooked Pork and Oat Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make stir fry dish made with twice cooked pork and oats, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Add the pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil. Stir to combine.
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes or until the pork is tender.
6. Add the oats and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the oats are well combined with the pork.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot over rice or noodles.
